ibadan-flood-channel.conditions_add: Before the 2014 credit could take effect, the World Bank required the Oyo State government to adopt a project manual, set up a project unit and an Independent Advisory Group, sign performance contracts with state agencies, and have the Governor approve in writing that the state's share of project costs be deducted at source each year and paid into the project account (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2014).

ibadan-flood-channel.searched: Case sources (Panel notice, 2024 restructuring paper); PAD 2014 (conditions of effectiveness); ICR 2025 (only financial covenants). Financing Agreement text link returned empty. No listed type fits these administrative conditions, so ct left empty.

jharkhand-santhal-water-plant.conditions_add: The 2014 Financing Agreement required India to have the states carry out the project under the environmental and social management frameworks and any Environmental Management Plans and Resettlement Action Plans, and required Jharkhand to follow its Tribal Development Plan (World Bank, Financing Agreement Credit 5345-IN, 2014). The Inspection Panel found that the Financing and Project Agreements required site-specific Environmental Management Plans to be sent to the Bank for review and approval before civil works, and that this was not done for the Bagbera and Chhotagovindpur schemes (Inspection Panel, Investigation Report, 2020).

why.safeguard: required site-specific Environmental Management Plans to be sent to the Bank for review and approval before civil works

webuye-interchange-traders.conditions_add: The 2011 Financing Agreement required Kenya to carry out the project in line with its safeguard instruments, which were a Resettlement Policy Framework and Resettlement Action Plans for the roads, including the Webuye-Kitale road (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2011). It also set a dated covenant to restructure the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority by separating its service role from its regulatory role by 31 December 2014 (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2011).

why.safeguard: required Kenya to carry out the project in line with its safeguard instruments, which were a Resettlement Policy Framework and Resettlement Action Plans

In October 2015 the Bank suspended disbursement, citing the Financing Agreement requirement to carry out the project in line with appropriate social standards and practices (Inspection Panel, Investigation Report, 2016).

why.safeguard: carrying out the environmental and social mitigation measures in the road's impact assessments was a covenant in the legal agreements

vishnugad-pipalkoti-haat.conditions_add: The 2011 loan was made to THDC India with a guarantee from the Republic of India (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2011). Its covenants required THDC to carry out the Resettlement Action Plan and Environmental Management Plan, to give affected people all their resettlement entitlements before building on their land, to measure river flows monthly, and not to take on debt above four times its equity (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2011).

why.safeguard: required THDC to carry out the Resettlement Action Plan and Environmental Management Plan
why.repay: with a guarantee from the Republic of India

giza-north-groundwater.conditions_add: The World Bank lent the 2010 money to Egypt, which passed it on to the state power company EEHC under a subsidiary loan agreement; signing that agreement was the condition for the loan to take effect, and dated covenants required a project unit by October 2010, a contract between EEHC and its subsidiary Cairo Electricity Production Company, a project manual and co-financing agreements by end-2011 (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2010). The appraisal document says the project 'does not have policy covenants' (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2010).

lbod-tidal-link-badin.conditions_add: Under the 1997 National Drainage Program credit, money for new drainage works could only flow to provincial irrigation authorities, area water boards and farmer groups that had been set up as autonomous bodies and were meeting business-plan targets for cutting costs, collecting abiana (water charges) and beneficiary contributions, aiming to cover their own running costs within seven to ten years (World Bank, Project Agreement and Development Credit Agreement Cr. 2999-PAK, 1997). The agreements also required an approved environmental assessment and an approved resettlement plan under the Framework for Land Acquisition and Resettlement before any works began (World Bank, Project Agreement, 1997). The Inspection Panel found the Bank had linked the investment money to progress on these institutional reforms (Inspection Panel, Investigation Report, 2006).

why.fees: meeting business-plan targets for cutting costs, collecting abiana (water charges) and beneficiary contributions
why.safeguard: required an approved environmental assessment and an approved resettlement plan under the Framework for Land Acquisition and Resettlement before any works began

IDA's project agreements with the pipeline company WAPCo and the gas seller N-Gas were to contain covenants that they act in line with World Bank environmental and social safeguard policies (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2004).

why.safeguard: covenants that they act in line with World Bank environmental and social safeguard policies

ijora-oloye-lagos-1998.conditions_add: The 1993 credit agreement barred spending on the Apapa drains and Surulere channel until Lagos State had hired a consultant, given IDA resettlement plans it accepted, and made progress on them before construction contracts were awarded (World Bank, Development Credit Agreement Cr. 2517-UNI, 1993). The Project Agreement required Lagos State to compensate all affected people so their living standards after resettlement were at least equal to before (World Bank, Project Agreement, 1993). A condition for the credit to take effect was draft bidding documents for contracting drain maintenance to private contractors (World Bank, Development Credit Agreement, 1993).

why.safeguard: barred spending on the Apapa drains and Surulere channel until Lagos State had hired a consultant, given IDA resettlement plans it accepted
why.priv: draft bidding documents for contracting drain maintenance to private contractors

planafloro-rondonia.conditions_add: A condition for the 1992 loan to take effect was that Rondônia sign an agreement with the federal land agency INCRA on land regularization policies consistent with forest protection, on terms the Bank accepted (Inspection Panel, Additional Review, citing Project Agreement Section 2.12(a) and Loan Agreement Section 6.01(b)). The Project Agreement also set a deadline of 31 December 1993 for contracting and completing the second stage of the state's agro-ecological zoning (Inspection Panel, Additional Review, citing Project Agreement Section 2.04).

why.land: Rondônia sign an agreement with the federal land agency INCRA on land regularization policies consistent with forest protection

cambodia-microfinance-land-loss.conditions_add: In six of IFC's 13 investments, the legal agreements had covenants requiring the Cambodian lender to follow good practice or Smart Campaign standards for protecting borrowers, with no reporting duty (CAO, Investigation Report, 2025). In investments made after 2012 (except North Haven Thai), IFC's Exclusion List, which bans impinging on Indigenous land, was attached to the legal agreements (CAO, Investigation Report, 2025).

why.safeguard: the legal agreements had covenants requiring the Cambodian lender to follow good practice or Smart Campaign standards for protecting borrowers

cambodia-microfinance-land-loss.searched: Case CAO investigation report 2025 (sections 4.3 and Exclusion List); LICADHO 2019 report (no lender terms).

karot-hydropower-workers.conditions_add: IFC's action plan for its 2016 loan required Karot Power to check its contractor's environmental and social plan, hire environmental and social advisers, and have contractors put a dispute-resolution clause in all labour contracts (CAO, Investigation Report, 2025). In 2020 IFC linked its 10th disbursement to fixing labour problems, then waived the gaps and paid when the company agreed a corrective action plan with deadlines after the payment (CAO, 2025). The Chinese-led US$1.292 billion loan was secured by a pledge of project assets, future electricity payments and a Sinosure credit insurance policy (AidData, project 37233).

why.safeguard: IFC's action plan for its 2016 loan required Karot Power to check its contractor's environmental and social plan
why.repay: secured by a pledge of project assets, future electricity payments and a Sinosure credit insurance policy

karot-hydropower-workers.searched: Case CAO investigation report 2025 (paras 74, SCAP); AidData 37233 (WebFetch). NEPRA data file has no terms.

baynouna-solar-herders.conditions_add: IFC's legal agreement with Baynouna had a general covenant requiring it to keep the commitments in its impact assessment, including the environmental and social management plan, and IFC's binding action plan required the company to meet herders who used the land to explain the project before construction began (CAO, Investigation Report, 2024). CAO found IFC set no time-bound conditions to reduce harm to Bedouin herders (CAO, 2024).

why.safeguard: IFC's binding action plan required the company to meet herders who used the land to explain the project before construction began

AidData's record of the 2018 Line 2 loan, in which ICBC took part, says no MIGA cover or partial risk guarantee was required (AidData, project 60921).
